description: View, create, boot, and interact with local iOS Simulators and Android emulators from a GitHub Copilot canvas, with the same device controls available to agents through an MCP server.
capabilities: stream and control ios simulators and android emulators
create, boot, and manage simulators and emulators
representativeQueries: Boot an iPhone simulator, install my app, and walk through sign in.
Find the Settings button on the Android emulator and tap it.
Take a screenshot of the current screen and describe any layout issues.
